Kai: Quick heads-up: onboarding run for Peregrine-22B int4 with RoPE-scaling at 64k showed reproducible KV aliasing around token ~31,200.
Rosa: Alias how? repeated spans or wrong token picks?
Kai: Repeats of a short phrase, exact across seeds. FP16 baseline fine. Kernel logs show ring_idx jumping from ~32780 -> 12 and reading same resolved key.
Min: 32780 -> 12 is suspiciously close to 32768 wrap. We had uint16 ring indices for some quant kernels to save memory.
Kai: Confirmed the quant-packed kernel uses uint16 in JIT. Re-running with a local uint32 promotion fixes the aliasing for the test.
Rosa: Good find. Action items: (1) Min to open PR to promote ring index width in quant-packed kernels, include microbench for perf delta, (2) Kai to add a router guard that blocks int4+rope-scaled for ctx>32k until patch lands, (3) add a unit fuzz test that toggles index width and injects long prefixes.
build-bot: CI queued: longctx-smoke-331 (Kai) artifacts s3://redwood-evals/kai/331/ ETA ~3m
Min: I'll run perf numbers locally. Expect small throughput regression (~1-4%) but correctness is higher priority.
Kai: I'll file ML ticket with KV dump and tiny repro seed and attach CI artifacts once available.
Rosa: Also draft a short Optimize doc blurb to warn users about quantized RoPE scaling on >32k until the fix is rolled.
Kai: Thanks team, will follow up with PR and CI links.
